chunks: And be not like those who have forgotten God, so that God has made them forget themselves. Such are the reprobates.

key_terms.فَأَنسَاهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ: so He made them forget themselves

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of forgetting God in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the reciprocal nature of divine forgetting, where spiritual negligence (ghaflah) leads to a loss of self-awareness (nafs), causing the individual to become estranged from their true fitrah. It is often linked to the concept of 'fasiq' not merely as a sinner, but as one who has transgressed the boundaries of their own soul due to this disconnect. This state serves as a warning against the complacency that prevents believers from maintaining constant mindfulness (muraqabah) of God.
